training.scope: Neural local value propagation learned on synthetic scalar Bellman targets; held random graphs evaluate multi-step shortest-path suggestions. Not language, general reasoning, or consciousness. Learned budget imitation, not discovered optimal resource allocation.

acceptance.scope: Finite16-node fully observed graph planning, three seeds; synthetic environment. Budget imitates explicit desired categories; not learned intrinsic goals or Chinese reasoning. Timing is CPU process time, not energy/power measurement.

navigation.scope: One explicit numeric goal per episode; subsequent inputs are synthetic action-result observations, not user prompts. Environment never searches for or suggests moves. Does not establish autonomous goal invention or physical computer control.

development_notes: Initial idle test incorrectly required a random clamped neural state to change. Replaced with an actual forward-call check because a fixed point is legitimate.
Session restart now invalidates previously observed environment even if no wall-clock checkpoint exists. No weights changed by this lifecycle fix.
CLI accepted commands checkpoint immediately; periodic thought checkpoints remain five seconds.

final_runtime_smoke.scope: Real process CLI, no repeated goals in demo; restart keeps target but invalidates stale observations; sleep has no neural steps.
